title: 第5章 抚摸小手的任务
content_zh:
爱美之心人皆有之，而且韩菱脾气性格都很好，加上姣好的身材面容，才会被评选为系花，而且据说至今还没有男朋友呢，所以这么一位美女坐到自己边上，展飞自然是略微有些不自在了。

而韩菱坐下来之后，把书一扔，然后扫了一眼展飞等人，然后便看起了自己的书了，而正当展飞正襟危坐的时候，脑海之中一个声音忽然道：“分支任务：抚摸系花的小手，是否接受？”

听到了这个声音，展飞顿时脸色一变，然后便闭上了眼睛，三秒钟之后，展飞便见到了自己的属性面板，而在属性面板的任务一栏，已经多了一个抚摸系花小手的任务，在那里还有一个问号，显然是在问展飞是不是接受？

看到这个任务，展飞吐血的心都有了，这是什么破任务？抚摸系花的小手？

自己和韩菱可不是太熟啊，就这么当众抚摸人家的手？韩菱会不会直接一耳光扇过来？然后自己在整个班级沦为笑柄？面临班上所有人的唾弃？

展飞当即便想放弃这个任务，只不过，随即他便想到，自己的这个游戏系统，应该是在现实之中随机触发的任务吧？而一般来讲，一个分支任务有着好几环的。

倘若自己放弃了这个任务，那么恐怕很长时间，都接收不到新的任务了，而且下次任务还不知道什么时候呢，凭借生活职业，自己几乎不可能升级，打怪更是没怪可打，所以貌似目前来讲，自己想要升级，只能够凭借这个任务了！

是接了？还是放弃了？考虑了片刻，展飞还是决定接下来，除了想发展自己的这个角色外，更多的，他内心深处，也是很想试试系花那小手的手感！随即展飞心一横，直接便点了一个接受，接着，任务状态便改变成了接受，而在下方，则是任务描述：“在一个半小时内抚摸到系花的小手，任务完成，可获得经验值五十点，任务失败，后续任务中断。”

看到了失败的惩罚，展飞也是松了一口气，没有什么严厉的惩罚就好，而任务完成，自己直接便能够升一级了，等级在前期的时候，提升起来还是很快的。

当然了，前提是展飞能够完成这项任务，一个半小时内完成任务，也就是在黑面的课结束之前，毕竟只有这两节课，展飞和系花距离最近了，上完课以后，想完成恐怕也几乎不可能呢？

而接下来，展飞脑中也是不断思索着该如何去完成这个任务，是装作不经意的碰触一下？还是直接开口请求对方？亦或者，不管三七二十一，抓了再说？展飞睁开了眼睛，偷偷看了一眼正在看书的韩菱，脑中不断思索着。

此刻韩菱心中也是有些好笑，这个家伙，自己一坐过来，就像是屁股上面坐了钉子一样，坐立不安，而一会儿，又闭上了眼睛，脸上又是各种表情，然后睁开眼睛，又偷偷瞄自己，是对自己有些想法吗？

对于展飞，韩菱可是没有什么特殊的感觉的，仅仅是同学罢了，毕竟想要有感觉，至少先留给对方一个特殊的印象吧？

展飞在班上四十多名男生之中，就是最普通的一个，不喜欢学习，逃逃课，玩玩游戏，没啥追求，甚至和班上很多男同学一样，都对她韩菱有些好感，如此一来，韩菱怎么可能对他有什么特别的想法？

所以微微摇了摇头，韩菱那里继续看着自己的书，而展飞此刻脑海之中，正想着是不是直接开口请韩菱让自己摸一下小手呢，结果看到韩菱摇头，顿时直接开口道：“就知道不同意啊。”

听到了展飞的话，韩菱眼中闪过了一丝异色，道：“什么不同意？”展飞也是愣了一下，才知道自己刚才走神了，急忙摇头道：“没，没事。”

韩菱听了，有些怪异的看了展飞一眼，然后继续看书了，而坐在展飞边上的周泰则是开口道：“老三？你发什么疯啊？怎么忽然自言自语了？”展飞听了，拍了一下周泰的大肚子，道：“我在想事情呢。”

周泰听了，道：“想事情？想什么？”展飞听了，低声道：“二哥，你有经验，你说我想抓一个女孩子的手，该怎么做？”

周泰听了，愣了一下，才道：“抓手？太简单了，直接动手不就行了？又不是亲嘴什么的，小事情而已，最多被甩开，对方不会生气的。”

听到了周泰的话，展飞问道：“真的？”

听到了周泰的话，展飞道：“那就好办了。”

展飞说着，直接便伸手，抓向了韩菱放在桌子上面的那只手，双手触碰的瞬间，展飞感觉到一种嫩嫩的软软的极为舒服的触感，而韩菱也在这个时候转过了头。

随即，两人四目相对，展飞能够感觉到，这双漂亮的大眼睛眼睛，似乎要喷火，接着展飞便看到了一只放大的拳头不断接近着，接着，展飞的右眼直接便变成了熊猫眼，而韩菱则是把自己的手抽回去，口中说了一句：“莫名其妙！”

而展飞则是悲剧的捂着自己的眼睛，而附近的不少人也都是笑了出来，还好，影响的范围不算大，仅仅十多人看到了这一幕，而展飞此刻则是异常的愤怒，他揉了揉自己的眼睛，然后才转头对正在那里笑的肚子疼的周泰道：“老二！你不是说没事情吗？”

周泰听了，边笑边道：“我的话你也信？你难道不知道我是理论帝吗？在网上我交过十个八个女朋友了，但是现实中，还没摸过女孩子的手呢，我就是怕像你现在这样啊！”

展飞听了，恶狠狠道：“回去再收拾你！”

展飞说着，闭上了眼睛，然后看起了自己的属性面板，至于说被系花打了一拳，之后带来的一些影响，却是被他选择性的遗忘了，面板之上，那个任务已经显示完成了，而新一环的任务暂时还是暗着的，应该需要一定的条件才能够触发。

而随即，展飞又看了看自己的经验栏那里，升级的那个图标，已经亮了起来，他能升级了！
content_en:
Everyone has a love for beauty, and Han Ling has a good temperament, plus a good figure and face, so she was selected as a beauty. It is said that she does not have a boyfriend yet, so when such a beautiful woman sits next to him, Zhan Fei naturally feels a little uncomfortable.

After Han Ling sat down, he threw the book away, glanced at Zhan Fei and others, and then started reading his own book. Just as Zhan Fei was sitting upright, a voice in his mind suddenly said: "Sub-task: touch the little hand of the flower, do you accept it?"

Hearing this voice, Zhan Fei's face suddenly changed, and then he closed his eyes. Three seconds later, Zhan Fei saw his attribute panel. In the task column of the attribute panel, there was already a task of stroking the flower-tie hand. There was also a question mark there, obviously asking Zhan Fei if he accepted it?

Seeing this mission, Zhan Fei vomited blood. What kind of useless mission is this?Touching the little hand holding the flower?

I am not very familiar with Han Ling, so I am touching her hand in public like this?Will Han Ling just slap him in the face?And then become the laughing stock of the entire class?Faced with being scorned by everyone in the class?

Zhan Fei wanted to give up on this mission, but then he thought that his game system should be a mission triggered randomly in reality, right?Generally speaking, a branch task has several links.

If I give up this mission, I'm afraid I won't be able to receive new missions for a long time, and I don't know when the next mission will be. With my life occupation, it is almost impossible for me to level up, and there are no monsters to fight, so it seems that for now, if I want to level up, I can only rely on this mission!

Did you answer it?Or gave up?After thinking about it for a moment, Zhan Fei decided to move forward. In addition to wanting to develop his own character, deep down in his heart, he also wanted to try the feel of Tie Hua's little hands!Immediately, Zhan Fei's heart changed and he clicked Accept. Then, the task status changed to Accept, and below it was the task description: "If you touch the flower-tying hand within one and a half hours, the task is completed and you will gain fifty experience points. If the task fails, subsequent tasks will be interrupted."

Seeing the punishment for failure, Zhan Fei breathed a sigh of relief. It was good that there was no severe punishment. After the task was completed, he could directly level up. In the early stage, the level increased very quickly.

Of course, the premise is that Zhan Fei can complete this task and complete the task within an hour and a half, that is, before the end of Heimian's class. After all, there are only these two classes. Zhan Fei and Xihua are the closest. After class, it will be almost impossible to complete it?

And next, Zhan Fei kept thinking about how to complete this task. Was he just pretending to touch it accidentally?Or just ask the other party directly?Or, don’t worry about it and wait until you’re caught?Zhan Fei opened his eyes and secretly glanced at Han Ling who was reading a book, thinking constantly in his mind.

At this moment, Han Ling was also a little funny. When this guy sat down, he felt as if there was a nail on his butt. He was restless. After a while, he closed his eyes again with various expressions on his face. Then he opened his eyes and glanced at himself secretly. Did he have some thoughts about himself?

Han Ling didn't have any special feelings for Zhan Fei. He was just a classmate. After all, if he wanted to have feelings for Zhan Fei, he had to at least leave a special impression on him, right?

Among the more than 40 boys in the class, Zhan Fei is the most ordinary one. He doesn't like studying, skips classes, plays games, and has no pursuits. Like many male classmates in the class, he even has a crush on her, Han Ling. In this case, how could Han Ling have any special thoughts about him?

So he shook his head slightly, and Han Ling continued to read his book. Zhan Fei was thinking about whether to directly ask Han Ling to touch his little hand, but when he saw Han Ling shaking his head, he immediately said directly: "I know I don't agree."

After hearing Zhan Fei's words, a strange look flashed in Han Ling's eyes, and she said, "Why don't you agree?" Zhan Fei was also stunned for a moment, then realized that he had been distracted just now, and hurriedly shook his head and said, "No, it's okay."

After hearing this, Han Ling gave Zhan Fei a strange look, and then continued reading. Zhou Tai, who was sitting next to Zhan Fei, said, "Third brother? Why are you crazy? Why are you talking to yourself all of a sudden?" After hearing this, Zhan Fei patted Zhou Tai's belly and said, "I was thinking about something."

Zhou Tai listened and said, "Thinking about something? What are you thinking about?" Zhan Fei listened and whispered, "Second brother, you have experience. You said I want to grab a girl's hand. What should I do?"

Zhou Tai was stunned for a moment after hearing this, and then said: "Grab the hand? It's too simple, why don't you just do it? It's not like a kiss, it's just a trivial matter. At most, the other party won't be angry if you are thrown away."

After hearing Zhou Tai's words, Zhan Fei asked, "Really?"

After hearing Zhou Tai's words, Zhan Fei said: "That will be easy to handle."

As Zhan Fei spoke, he reached out and grabbed Han Ling's hand on the table. The moment his hands touched, Zhan Fei felt a tender, soft and extremely comfortable touch, and Han Ling also turned his head at this time.

Immediately, the two people's eyes met, and Zhan Fei could feel that these beautiful big eyes seemed to be breathing fire. Then Zhan Fei saw an enlarged fist approaching, and then Zhan Fei's right eye turned into a panda eye, while Han Ling pulled his hand back and said: "Inexplicable!"

Zhan Fei covered his eyes in tragedy, and many people nearby also laughed. Fortunately, the scope of the impact was not large. Only a dozen people saw this scene, and Zhan Fei was extremely angry at the moment. He rubbed his eyes, and then turned to Zhou Tai, who was laughing there and had a stomachache, and said: "Second brother! Didn't you say nothing was wrong?"

After hearing this, Zhou Tai smiled and said: "Do you believe what I say? Don't you know that I am the emperor of theory? I have had ten or eight girlfriends online, but in reality, I have never touched a girl's hand. I am just afraid of being like you now!"

After Zhan Fei heard this, he said fiercely: "I'll deal with you when I get back!"

Zhan Fei said, closed his eyes, and then looked at his attribute panel. As for being punched by Tie Hua, some of the subsequent effects were selectively forgotten by him. On the panel, it showed that the task had been completed, and the task of the new link was still hidden for the time being, and it should require certain conditions to be triggered.

And then, Zhan Fei looked at his experience bar again. The upgrade icon had lit up. He could upgrade!
